Book Your School Tour at
Launcelot Primary School & Nursery
We are delighted to welcome you to our wonderful school, and we hope you'll discover what makes Launcelot such a special place to learn and grow.
At Launcelot, we pride ourselves on being a warm and friendly community where every child, family member and staff member is valued. Our children are enthusiastic learners who approach each day with curiosity and joy, supported by our dedicated staff who work tirelessly to ensure every child reaches their full potential.
Book Your Place at Our Tour Days
We are holding open mornings during term time, from October to December 2026.
October Dates (See our swimming pool on site this month)
All tours start at 9:15am:
Thursday 8th October
Wednesday 14th October
Tuesday 20th October
November Dates
All tours start at 9:15am:
Tuesday 3rd November
Wednesday 18th November
December Dates
All tours start at 9:15am:
Thursday 3rd December
How to Book
Please contact our admin team to reserve your place:
We look forward to welcoming you to Launcelot.

Phone: 020 8697 2304
